schema.sdl:
scalar DateTime
scalar JSON
scalar Map

enum Rarity {
  Common
  Rare
  Legendary
}

input SpeciesFilter {
  name: String
  rarities: [Rarity!]
  limit: Int = 10
  nested: SpeciesFilter
}

type Query {
  species(
    filter: SpeciesFilter
    since: DateTime
    weight: Float
    ratio: Float
    huge: Float
    small: Float
    neg: Float
    nested: SpeciesFilter
  ): [Species!]!
}

type Species {
  id: Int!
  name: String!
  rarity: Rarity!
  stats: JSON!
  attributes: Map
  born: DateTime
}

inputs.text:
query Enums(
  $filter: SpeciesFilter = { name: "charmander" }
  $since: DateTime
  $weight: Float = 0.0000001
  $ratio: Float = 1.5
  $huge: Float = 1e21
  $small: Float = 1e-7
  $neg: Float = -1.5
  $nested: SpeciesFilter = { name: "bulbasaur", limit: 3 }
) {
  species(
    filter: $filter
    since: $since
    weight: $weight
    ratio: $ratio
    huge: $huge
    small: $small
    neg: $neg
    nested: $nested
  ) {
    id
    name
    rarity
    stats
    attributes
    born
  }
}

# Schema shape for the Pokédex fixture API.
#

# field and argument names (and their nullability) follow the shape documented

type Query {
	pokemon(first: Int, after: String): SpeciesConnection!

}

type Species {
	id: Int!
	pokedexNumber: Int!
	name: String!
	flavor_text: String!
	base_stats: Map!
	favorite: Boolean!
	evolution_chain: [Species!]!
	moves(first: Int, after: String, last: Int, before: String): SpeciesMoveConnection!
	types: [Type!]!
	sprites: SpeciesSprites!
}

type SpeciesSprites {
	front: String!
	back: String!
}

type SpeciesMove {
	learned_at: Int!
	method: String!
	move: Move!
}

type Move {
	name: String!
	power: Int
	accuracy: Int
	pp: Int!
	type: Type
}

	Grass
	Poison
	Fire
	Flying
	Water
	Bug
	Normal
	Electric
	Ground
	Fairy
	Fighting
	Psychic
	Rock
	Steel
	Ice
	Ghost
	Dragon
	Dark
}

	edges: [SpeciesEdge!]!
	pageInfo: PageInfo!
	totalCount: Int!
}

	cursor: String
	node: Species
}

type SpeciesMoveConnection {
	edges: [SpeciesMoveEdge!]!
	pageInfo: PageInfo!
	totalCount: Int!
}

type SpeciesMoveEdge {
	cursor: String
	node: SpeciesMove
}

type PageInfo {
	endCursor: String
	hasNextPage: Boolean!
	hasPreviousPage: Boolean!
	startCursor: String
}

type Mutation {
	toggleFavorite(id: Int!): ToggleFavoriteOutput
}

type ToggleFavoriteOutput {
	species: Species
}

type Subscription {
	speciesFavoriteToggled: SpeciesFavoriteToggledOutput!
}

type SpeciesFavoriteToggledOutput {
	species: Species!
}

/** Typed `graphql()`: a keyed lookup, not an overload table. */
export interface DocumentMap {
  "fragment Alpha on Species {\n    id\n}\n": typeof import('./artifacts/Alpha').default
  "query Beta {\n    __typename\n}\n": typeof import('./artifacts/Beta').default
  "query Info {\n    __typename\n}\n": typeof import('./artifacts/Info').default
  "fragment Info on Species {\n    id\n}\n": typeof import('./artifacts/Info').default
  "query info {\n    __typename\n}\n": typeof import('./artifacts/info').default
}

/**
 * The `graphql()` fallback: the template text is not a key in `DocumentMap`.
 *
 * This type exists to be *named* in the error. A stale template (the document
 * was edited without running `flamme generate`) is the cause, so the fallback
 * type says so; a `never` fallback instead type-checked silently at the call
 * site and produced a misleading downstream error ("Property … does not exist
 * on type 'never'").
 */
export interface FLM_DocumentNotInGeneratedMap {
  readonly ' $documentNotInGeneratedMap': 'run `flamme generate`: this document text is not in DocumentMap'
}

export function graphql<T extends keyof DocumentMap>(source: T): DocumentMap[T]
export function graphql(source: string): FLM_DocumentNotInGeneratedMap
export function graphql(source: string): never {
  throw new Error(`graphql() must be compiled away: ${source.slice(0, 40)}`)
}
